rule: The Eastern-Central boundary in Indiana (49 CFR 71.5(b)) runs along county lines: around LaPorte, Starke, Jasper and Newton counties in the northwest and along the north lines of Gibson, Warrick and Spencer counties and around Perry County in the southwest; the twelve counties listed lie wholly west of it, in the Central zone. The rest of the state keeps Eastern time.
